H1, H2, then another H1 creates two sibling top-level groups

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
use HtmlToMarkdown\DocumentStructure;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["includeDocumentStructure" => true]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<h1>Chapter One</h1><h2>Section A</h2><p>Section A content.</p><h1>Chapter Two</h1><h2>Section B</h2><p>Section B content.</p>", $options);
var_dump($result);
```
